summary: Completed frontend testing of Live TV page fixes including top navigation, scrollable channel list, and visible video playback

ui_bugs.issue: Direct navigation to /watch/{id} redirects to browse page instead of showing video player
ui_bugs.workaround: Users must navigate via Browse > Channel > Watch Now button to access video player

passed_tests: Live TV page has top navigation bar
Live TV page has scrollable channel list with 14 channels
Videos play visibly with proper iframe dimensions (1584x754px)
Video URLs correctly exclude controls=0 parameter for visible playback
Channel switching works via up/down buttons and channel list selection
Watch page has top navigation when accessed via Browse > Watch Now
Video player component displays correctly with full dimensions (1920x1080px)
YouTube embed URLs are properly formatted with autoplay and start time parameters
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix Watch page direct routing - /watch/{id} should display video player directly instead of redirecting to browse page
